                    toStringCache = new String[128];
                    for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
                        toStringCache[i] = String.valueOf((char) i);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return toStringCache[ch];
    }
    return String.valueOf(ch);
}

// The cache array is declared as a private static field of the class.
// It is lazily initialized in a thread-safe manner.
private static volatile String[] toStringCache;
